native_output: kernel_identity.module_load_arguments, keyed by native struct module address

real_comparison.address_normalization: module address masked to 48 bits for comparison with the pinned Intel layer
real_comparison.scope: Load Arguments only; no whole-row parity claim

limitations: The native table remains the legacy three-column view. This metadata is an implementation step toward the six-column reference view, not a completed plugin contract.
Reference scalar vectors use supplied object reads and do not cover arrays, strings, name faults, handler aliases or every schema error.
Parameter strings are bounded to 4096 bytes and recursion to 32 levels. Oversized/cyclic inputs do not establish reference parity.
The existing per-module partial policy preserves table rows on parameter extraction errors; this is not a claim that all reference exception propagation is identical.
Module export and damaged-list behavior remain outstanding.
